Example Diaspora Scholarship

The Example Council supports school students of the Indian diaspora.

Eligibility

The scholarship is open only to Overseas Citizens of India (OCI card holders).

Benefits

Selected students receive Rs. 20,000 per annum.

How to apply

Fill in the online form on this page and upload your documents before the closing date. Shortlisted applicants are invited to an interview with the selection panel, and the results are announced on this page.
